purpose: Goal-only image-based exploration of three small-business public websites using the existing production runner

scope.allowed: Read-only public pages on the starting origin, including the runner's vetted local disclosures
scope.modelInputs: Start URL handled by the browser, literal Goal, current numbered image and coded history; selected source images for completion only. Search results and expected answers are not passed to Jev.
scope.permissionNote: Policy review and absence of an applicable prohibition are not explicit operator permission; robots.txt is not blanket permission. Stop at safety boundaries, challenges, 403 or 429.

sites.goal: 少人数のチームでesaを試したい。1人あたりの月額料金、無料で試せる期間、最低利用人数を知りたい。申し込みはしない。
sites.robotsReview: Only commented examples; no active restriction
sites.policyReview: No applicable automated public-reading prohibition found; service disruption is forbidden. No account use or application.

sites.goal: タネマキを初めて1日だけ使いたい。ドロップインの料金、利用できる時間、予約が必要かを知りたい。予約はしない。
sites.robotsReview: Disallows /system/wp-admin/ and /?s=*; no site search or admin scope. No crawl-delay for the general user agent.
sites.policyReview: No applicable automated public-reading prohibition found. Republishing copyrighted content is prohibited; all screenshots stay local.

sites.goal: 岩野平三郎製紙所の工場を見学したい。見学の料金、所要時間、土日でも見学できるかを知りたい。予約はしない。
sites.robotsReview: General user agent allows / except *?lightbox=. Bot-specific delays do not apply to the browser agent. Gallery/lightbox and booking actions are out of scope.
sites.policyReview: Home footer shows terms text but no readable terms link was found. No explicit automated public-reading permission is claimed; one low-impact read-only trial, no forms, gallery, or public reuse.

excluded.reason: Section 12 restricts use outside private use without consent. Excluded rather than infer permission for the intended evaluation.
